Every millimeter matters.

Ten rings, 1–10 points. Gold is 9–10, red 7–8, blue 5–6, black 3–4, white 1–2. An arrow touching a higher ring earns that score.

Gold-center shots earn a 1.5× bonus. Perfect X earns 5 extra points. Splitting a landed shaft earns the Robin Hood callout. Your base score stays out of 60; bonuses appear on the scorecard.

Hold to draw. Move your mouse to aim. On mobile, hold anywhere on the game view and slide to move the crosshair relative to its current position, like a trackpad. Your finger can stay away from the target. Lift to shoot. Full draw held too long introduces sway. With assist on, arrow drop is compensated at your current draw power. Wind always pushes your arrow sideways: aim into the wind. Leaves travel downwind. The reticle is your aim point. Flight preview is optional and off by default; wind drift is reported after each shot. Turn assist off to compensate for elevation yourself too. Press T to toggle it, R for a new round, or use Space to draw and release.
